title: Validate a Hall Pass Code
description: Return `True` only when a code contains exactly two uppercase ASCII letters, a hyphen, and four digits (for example, `AB-0427`). Reject all other strings.

solution.explanation: Use re.fullmatch with two uppercase letters, a hyphen, and four digits. Full matching rejects extra prefixes, suffixes, spaces, or wrong case. Returning a Boolean keeps validation separate from display.

tests.hint: Check a valid code with a leading zero.
Letters and digits may use any allowed values.
An extra letter makes the entire string invalid.
The digit section needs four digits.
The digit section cannot be longer than four.
Every trailing character must be a digit.
Full matching should reject a very long invalid prefix.
